description: This file is part of the pip internal implementations, specifically handling distribution preparation, requirement handling, downloading, unpacking, and metadata fetching in the package installation process.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with path and content type.

classes.name: RequirementPreparer
classes.description: Handles preparation and fetching of Python package requirements for installation, including downloading, unpacking, metadata extraction, and validation.

methods.name: BaseDistribution _get_prepared_distribution( req: InstallRequirement, build_tracker: BuildTracker, finder: PackageFinder, build_isolation: bool, check_build_deps: bool, )
methods.description: Prepares a distribution object for installation based on the requirement.

methods.name: None unpack_vcs_link(link: Link, location: str, verbosity: int)
methods.description: Unpacks a version control system link into a specified location.

methods.name: File get_http_url( link: Link, download: Downloader, download_dir: Optional[str] = None, hashes: Optional[Hashes] = None, )
methods.description: Downloads a URL and returns a File object representing the downloaded file.

methods.name: File get_file_url( link: Link, download_dir: Optional[str] = None, hashes: Optional[Hashes] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves a local file URL, optionally verifying hashes.

methods.name: Optional[File] unpack_url( link: Link, location: str, download: Downloader, verbosity: int, download_dir: Optional[str] = None, hashes: Optional[Hashes] = None, )
methods.description: Downloads and unpacks a URL resource into a specified location.

methods.name: Optional[str] _check_download_dir( link: Link, download_dir: str, hashes: Optional[Hashes], warn_on_hash_mismatch: bool = True, )
methods.description: Checks if a file already exists in the download directory and verifies its hash.

methods.name: BaseDistribution prepare_linked_requirement( self, req: InstallRequirement, parallel_builds: bool = False )
methods.description: Prepares a requirement to be obtained from a link, handling download, unpacking, and metadata.

methods.name: None prepare_linked_requirements_more( self, reqs: Iterable[InstallRequirement], parallel_builds: bool = False )
methods.description: Prepares multiple linked requirements more thoroughly, including navigating partial downloads.

methods.name: None save_linked_requirement(self, req: InstallRequirement)
methods.description: Saves the requirement link to the download directory.

methods.name: BaseDistribution prepare_editable_requirement( self, req: InstallRequirement, )
methods.description: Prepares an editable requirement, fetching source and metadata.

methods.name: BaseDistribution prepare_installed_requirement( self, req: InstallRequirement, skip_reason: str, )
methods.description: Prepares an already installed requirement for metadata access.

methods.name: Optional[BaseDistribution] _fetch_metadata_only( self, req: InstallRequirement, )
methods.description: Attempts to fetch only the metadata of a requirement, if possible.

methods.name: Optional[BaseDistribution] _fetch_metadata_using_link_data_attr( self, req: InstallRequirement, )
methods.description: Fetches metadata from a data-dist-info-metadata attribute if available.

methods.name: Optional[BaseDistribution] _fetch_metadata_using_lazy_wheel( self, link: Link, )
methods.description: Fetches metadata from a lazy-loading wheel, if applicable.
